controllerType: A6F-E/Q/PK Electronic Control System (stepping motor variant)
type: Computerized lockstitch machine with cloth puller stepping motor and back-tacking stepping motor
source: Jack A6F-E/Q/PK款说明书 20230105 English (30 pages)
note: This model series differs from the base A6F by adding: cloth puller stepping motor, back-tacking stepping motor, voice navigation, W sewing, multi-segment sewing, pattern freedom sewing, and tight seam function. Error codes E80-E107 are specific to stepping motor subsystems.

buttons.name: Stitch length +
buttons.longPress: Increase cloth puller stitch length (when cloth puller enabled)
buttons.note: Dual function depending on cloth puller enable state

buttons.name: Stitch length -
buttons.longPress: Decrease cloth puller stitch length (when cloth puller enabled)

buttons.name: Lock needle / Needle stop position
buttons.click: Cycle needle lock: front → back → both → cancel

buttons.name: Presser foot after trim / Presser foot after pause
buttons.click: Toggle presser foot behavior after thread trim
buttons.longPress: Toggle presser foot behavior after pause

buttons.name: P (parameter edit)
buttons.inMain: Long-press to enter parameter setting mode
buttons.inParameter: Press to save current value and exit parameter

userParams.access: Long-press P button in main screen → display shows parameter code → use Left/Right to navigate, +/- to adjust → press P to save and exit

technicianParams.access: Hold P button while powering on machine → display shows P92 → use Left/Right to navigate, +/- to adjust → press P to save and exit
technicianParams.description: Technician-level parameters requiring service access. Entry confirmed by P92 display at boot.

parameterEntry.factoryReset: Long-press Reset button to restore all factory defaults

features: Cloth puller stepping motor with positioning sensor
Back-tacking stepping motor (electronically controlled back-tack timing)
Voice navigation (boot speech, error code broadcasting via voice)
W sewing mode (width sewing for special stitch patterns)
Two-level parameter access: User (P01-P43) and Technician (P44-P254)

errorCodes.description: Over-voltage protection triggered
errorCodes.solution: Check power supply voltage is within normal range. If voltage is normal, replace control box.

errorCodes.description: Low-voltage protection triggered
errorCodes.solution: Check power supply voltage is within normal range. If voltage is normal, replace control box.

errorCodes.description: CPU communication error (panel to main board communication failure)
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check panel connector and cable for loose connections. 2) Restart machine. 3) If persists, replace control box.

errorCodes.description: Speed control unit (governor) connection abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check speed controller connector and cable. If connection is good, replace control box.

errorCodes.description: Main shaft motor rotating abnormally
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check if spindle is mechanically locked — try rotating handwheel by hand. 2) Check encoder connector and motor power cables. 3) Verify input voltage is normal. 4) Check if sewing speed is set too high.

errorCodes.description: Positioning signal error
errorCodes.solution: Check motor encoder connector — may be loose or have fallen off. If connector is secure, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Solenoid over-current protection
errorCodes.solution: Check if solenoid is broken or shorted.

errorCodes.description: Positioning signal error
errorCodes.solution: Check motor encoder connector — may be loose or have fallen off. If connector is secure, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Encoder signal error
errorCodes.solution: Check motor encoder connector for loose or damaged connection. If secure, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Power module abnormal over-current protection
errorCodes.solution: 1) Power cycle the machine (turn off, wait, turn on). 2) If persists, replace control box.

errorCodes.description: Safety switch alarm (machine head open or safety switch triggered)
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check that machine head is fully closed. 2) Check ball switch inside control box.

errorCodes.description: Motor start failed
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check motor encoder connector. 2) Check motor power socket. 3) Restart machine. 4) If persists, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Shutdown failure — machine reached password-locked time limit
errorCodes.solution: Machine has reached its preset operating time under password lock. Contact service provider to unlock or extend.

errorCodes.description: Crystal oscillator of panel abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Replace panel PCB.

errorCodes.description: Abnormal communication between main CPU and stepping motor driver CPU
errorCodes.solution: Turn off machine and restart. If persists, check stepping motor driver board connections.

errorCodes.description: Back-tacking stepping motor overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check stepping motor connector and wiring. 2) Restart machine.

errorCodes.description: Back-tacking stepping motor encoder Z signal abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check encoder wiring: black, blue, and pink wires for loose or damaged connections.

errorCodes.description: Back-tacking stepping motor encoder AB signal abnormal
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check encoder wiring: black, brown, and orange wires. 2) Check if outer ring of motor disc is covered in oil (clean if so).

errorCodes.description: Back-tacking stepping motor failed to start
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check motor connector and power cable. 2) If connections are good, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Back-tacking stepping motor locked-rotor (motor stalled or mechanically jammed)
errorCodes.solution: Check if motor is mechanically locked or obstructed. If motor is free but error persists, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller stepping motor overcurrent
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check cloth puller motor connector and wiring. 2) Restart machine.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller motor does not stop at specified position (positioning failure)
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check cloth puller sensor position and alignment. 2) Restart machine.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller stepping motor encoder Z signal abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check cloth puller motor encoder connector for loose or damaged connection.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller stepping motor encoder AB signal abnormal
errorCodes.solution: Check cloth puller motor encoder connector for loose or damaged connection.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller stepping motor failed to start
errorCodes.solution: 1) Check cloth puller motor connector and power cable. 2) If connections are good, replace motor.

errorCodes.description: Cloth puller stepping motor locked-rotor (motor stalled or mechanically jammed)
errorCodes.solution: Check if cloth puller mechanism is mechanically jammed. If mechanism is free but error persists, replace motor.

parameters.name: User Parameter Group
parameters.description: User-level adjustable parameters. Access via long-press P button. Navigate with Left/Right, adjust with +/-. Save with P.

parameters.name: Technician Parameter Group (Part 1)
parameters.description: Technician-level parameters. Includes machine-specific settings for timing, solenoids, motor behavior, cloth puller, and back-tacking stepping motor configuration.

parameters.name: Technician Parameter Group (Part 2)
parameters.description: Additional technician parameters for advanced stepping motor configuration, cloth puller fine-tuning, and system behavior settings.

troubleshooting.cause: An error has been detected and the voice broadcast function is announcing it
troubleshooting.solution: Note the error code being announced. Refer to the error code table (E01-E107) for the specific cause and remedy. The voice function is activated by long-pressing the Boot Speech/Voice button.

troubleshooting.cause: Back-tacking stepping motor error (E82-E87) or parameter setting issue
troubleshooting.solution: 1) Check for error codes E82-E87 on display. 2) Verify back-tacking button cycles correctly (1×/2×/off). 3) Check P button technician parameters related to back-tacking motor steps/timing.

troubleshooting.cause: Cloth puller stepping motor error (E102-E107) or cloth puller function disabled
troubleshooting.solution: 1) Check error codes E102-E107. 2) Confirm cloth puller is enabled (long-press End back-tacking button toggles cloth puller). 3) Verify motor connector (12P port pins 2,8 for cloth puller DC motor).

troubleshooting.issue: Machine will not start / E30 error
troubleshooting.solution: Contact Jack service provider to reset or extend the machine's operating time license.

troubleshooting.issue: E80 stepping motor CPU communication error
troubleshooting.cause: Communication failure between main control board and stepping motor driver module
troubleshooting.solution: Power cycle the machine. If error persists after restart, the stepping motor driver board or its communication cable may need replacement.

troubleshooting.issue: E85 encoder AB signal error — back-tacking motor
troubleshooting.cause: Encoder wiring fault or oil contamination on motor disc outer ring
troubleshooting.solution: Check black, brown, orange wires on encoder. Visually inspect the outer ring of the motor encoder disc — clean if oil is present, as this blocks the optical sensor.

16P_function_port.description: 16-pin function connector for sensors and accessories

12P_function_port.description: 12-pin function connector for solenoids and actuators
